READ THE PROOF

Why the bound is tight

3Recorded lower bound · 2 + 2 − 1

Every pair obeys u + v ≤ cost. Resource potentials are nonpositive, and unused resources have zero potential. Equality on each selected edge makes the assignment attain the lower bound.
